scope: Independent read-only source/UI contract review; browser rendering is verified separately by the root agent.

checks.name: Focused UI regressions
checks.evidence: npx vitest run tests/trends.test.jsx tests/opportunity-repair.test.jsx tests/waivers-ui.test.jsx: 19 tests passed across 3 files. After corrections, node --test tests/waivers-api.test.mjs passed 7 tests and npx vitest run tests/waivers-ui.test.jsx passed 10 tests.

checks.name: Shared metric selectors
checks.evidence: OpportunityTracker, App and Waivers all render TrendMetricSelect from TrendChart.jsx; the complete 19-metric catalogue includes position_finish. Opportunity choices persist independently for each position and all three chart slots.

checks.name: Comparable scales and missing/zero/negative values
checks.evidence: server/trend-history.mjs derives zero-inclusive domains across NFL peers before user filters. TrendChart renders signed bars against that domain and distinguishes null from zero; focused tests check a 42:2 ratio and negative bars.

checks.name: Aligned season/week slots
checks.evidence: Player Database and Opportunity share calendarSlots and 2025-to-2026 alignedHistory. Corrected Waivers independently obtains history for known IDs absent from selected-statistics rows. Live local function readback asserts Penix history equality across Waivers and Opportunity, null current-week points, and ten aligned slots for every known waiver ID.

checks.name: Opportunity filters and saved selections
checks.evidence: Statistics year, scoring, team, 5/8/10-week history and independent matchup weeks reach their intended query/control state. Six focused tests cover range/extras preservation, reload, corrupt preferences, reset and stale-request handling.

checks.name: Column controls remain reachable
checks.evidence: App.jsx exposes Column options in the table heading independently of collapsed column groups; Table Settings remains separately reachable. Waivers Table settings remains in its fixed toolbar.

checks.name: DFS dated context and unavailable values
checks.evidence: App renders DFS salary season/week separately from statistics season, current slate metadata, sources and capture timestamp, null values as unavailable and last-good availabilityMessage. Root's contemporaneous correction suppresses Shark Snip for a declared projectionProvider.

checks.name: Weekly positional finish meaning
checks.evidence: Backend uses competition RANK across all NFL peers before filtering. App shows exact week. Waivers source readback now includes dedicated position/scoring/week tooltip and POS FIN context at Waivers.jsx:129,146 after root correction.

findings.title: Do not gate historical charts on current selected-week totals
findings.detail: Original defect: Waivers created trends only from stat.player_trends after joining selected-week totals. Root corrected this with queryPlayerHistories and one additional history lookup for absent known IDs. Independent readback and regression tests pass.
findings.reproduction: Before correction: queryWaivers(season=2026&week=2&weeks=1), with an injected empty market provider, yielded Michael Penix Jr. (00-0039917) stats.trends=[] and meta.trendSlots.length=10 while Opportunity returned ten slots. After correction both views return those ten slots, including 2025-10 passAttempts=28 and 2025-11 passAttempts=16, with 2026-1 correctly null.
findings.expected: Resolve aligned history independently by stable player ID, retain null selected-week totals, and preserve slot-shaped null history for known players without recorded values.
findings.coverageGap: Closed: tests/waivers-api.test.mjs now checks real Penix prior-season values, current missing values and matching slot counts for every known player ID.

findings.title: Label POS FIN with its actual week, position and scoring
findings.detail: Originally inherited the selected-range generic stat tooltip. Root corrected it during review with a dedicated exact-week, scoring and position tooltip and POS FIN context line. Source readback verified; all ten existing Waivers UI regressions passed after correction.
